texts.li: {A_nameDef} called a name across the canyon to see what would happen. The rock threw it back three times, and on a ledge across the gap {X_indefinite} lifted its head at each one.
At the bottom of the canyon the sky was a strip of blue far overhead. {A_nameDef} looked up and saw {X_indefinite} on a ledge halfway up the wall, looking down at {A_objective} with mild interest.
[morning] The sun reaches the canyon floor late. {A_nameDef} waited for it on a cold rock, and {X_indefinite} came down the scree to wait for it too, a few paces off.
[child] {A_nameDef} shouted into the canyon and the canyon shouted back, and {X_indefinite} on the far side jumped every time. {A_nameDef} thought this was the best game there was.
The valley was full of mist at dawn, white to the brim, with only the hilltops showing. {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} come up out of it as if out of a lake, shaking off the wet.
From the slope above the colony, {A_nameDef} could see the whole valley floor, and {X_indefinite} crossing it, small as a seed, leaving a dark line through the dew.
[cold] Cold air sinks into the valley overnight and sits there. {A_nameDef} climbed up into the first of the sun and found {X_indefinite} already there, warming its back.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: the way out of the valley

texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} had come in by the only easy way and told {A_nameDef} there were two more, one of them a goat track nobody uses twice. {A_nameDef} asked where it starts.

{X_nameDef} looked up at the walls around the colony and told {A_nameDef} it was a fine place to live and a terrible place to be found by raiders. Then {X_pronoun} showed {A_objective} where a lookout would see the whole approach.

[rain] The rain came down the valley sides in a hundred little streams. {X_nameDef} watched them with {A_nameDef} and said that in {FACTION}'s country they dig a ditch above every house for exactly this.

{A_nameDef} walked the whole way round the island before supper, and at every turn there was the sea. Halfway, {X_indefinite} fell in behind {A_objective} for a while, as if it was doing the same thing.
From the high point of the island {A_nameDef} could see water on every side and nothing else, and {X_indefinite} grazing at {A_possessive} feet as though that were perfectly ordinary.
[storm] Spray came right over the island in the storm. {A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} both sheltered in the lee of the same rock, soaked and blinking.
[evening] The sun went down into the sea on one side of the island while the moon came up out of it on the other. {A_nameDef} sat between them with {X_indefinite} not far off.

At dusk the cave breathes out cold air you can feel from twenty paces. {A_nameDef} stood in it to cool off, and {X_indefinite} came out of the dark behind {A_objective} and went off into the evening without a glance.
{A_nameDef} sat by the cave mouth as the light went and heard things moving inside: dripping water, a scrabble of claws. Then {X_indefinite} came out, saw {A_objective}, and thought better of it.
[summer] On the hottest day yet, {A_nameDef} found the coolest place in the colony, the mouth of the cave, with {X_indefinite} already lying in it.

{A_nameDef} walked along the foot of the cliffs, where the stones that fall end up, and met {X_indefinite} picking its way the other way. They passed each other with the polite distance of strangers on a narrow street.
The cliff face turns gold in the late afternoon. {A_nameDef} stopped work to look at it, and noticed {X_indefinite} at the bottom of it, gold too.
[rain] After the rain, water ran down the cliff in thin silver lines. {A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} both drank from the pool at the bottom, at opposite ends.
Everything that lives for a day's walk around comes to the oasis to drink. {A_nameDef} sat in the shade of the palms and watched {X_indefinite} come down to the water, careful and thirsty.
{A_nameDef} filled the buckets at the green water and found {X_indefinite} drinking on the far side, so close across the pool that {A_pronoun} could hear it swallow.
[night] By moonlight the oasis was busy. {A_nameDef} counted the shapes that came to drink, and {X_indefinite} was the last and boldest of them.
[hot] In the worst of the heat, the only green for miles and the only cool. {A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} shared it without fuss.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} stood on the rim with {A_nameDef} and told {A_objective} what {FACTION} say made the great bowl of land the colony sits in. {A_nameDef} has heard three stories about it now, and they don't agree.

{X_nameDef} said the crater was the only place for a week's walk where the wind didn't reach the ground, and that {FACTION}'s caravans used to winter in it. {A_nameDef} hadn't known anyone had lived here before.
[theirHightech] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} the crater was made by something falling from orbit, long ago, and pointed out the ring of shattered rock that proves it.
[theirLowtech] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, very seriously, that a star fell here once and the ground still remembers it. {A_nameDef} looked at the rim differently afterwards.

Two rainbows stood over the colony together, one inside the other, the inner one bright and the outer one faint and backwards. {A_nameDef} stopped dead to look, and so, for no reason anyone could give, did {X_indefinite}.
{A_nameDef} came out after the rain and found the sky crossed by a double rainbow, with {X_indefinite} grazing right under the near end of it as if that were nothing special.
[child] {A_nameDef} ran to tell everyone there were two rainbows, and then ran back in case they'd gone. They hadn't, and {X_indefinite} was still standing under them.

The wind blew all day without a break, flattening the grass in long silver waves. {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} lean into it across the field with its fur blown the wrong way, looking thoroughly offended.
{A_nameDef} chased a hat from the storehouse to the far fence in the wind and finally caught it right under the nose of {X_indefinite}, which had been watching the whole chase.
[fall] The wind stripped the last leaves off everything in an afternoon. {A_nameDef} stood in the whirl of them while {X_indefinite} snapped at the ones that came too close.

When the dust came over, {A_nameDef} pulled a cloth over {A_possessive} face and ducked into the lee of the wall, where {X_indefinite} had had the same idea. They waited it out side by side with their eyes shut.
The dust turned the sun into a dull orange coin. {A_nameDef} could just make out {X_indefinite} through it, standing head down and tail to the wind, waiting for it to pass like everyone else.
[hot] Hot wind and grit in everything. {A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} both gave up and lay flat in the shade of the storehouse until the worst blew through.
